subject: Request: technical deep-dive on inference routing and latency for Parcel.ai
messages:
From: Erin Walsh <erin@parcel.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-01-18T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Quickstart CTA — request for technical demo on routing/latency

Hi Jordan,

I clicked through the developer quickstart and selected the option to request a technical deep-dive. Parcel.ai is evaluating inference options for our real-time email routing product — we need sub-150ms p95 for short prompts at ~60 qps with bursty spikes to 300 qps.

High-level ask: a 30–45 minute technical session to discuss how Redwood handles continuous batching, KV cache behavior, and routing variants (hosted vs dedicated). Also want to cover PII/data residency constraints — we operate in us-west and need to understand encryption/KMS options.

Preferred windows (PST):
- Tue Jan 20: 10:00–11:30
- Wed Jan 21: 09:00–12:00

I'll loop in our infra engineer if needed. Attaching a small sample traffic file (headers + qps profile).

Thanks,
Erin Walsh
Product Ops, Parcel.ai
erin@parcel.ai
[Attachment: sample-traffic.tsv (text/tab-separated-values)]
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Erin Walsh <erin@parcel.ai>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-01-18T11:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Quickstart CTA — request for technical demo on routing/latency

Erin — great to meet you over email and thanks for the sample traffic.

Happy to run a focused session on batching, KV cache, and routing/failover behavior. For the 30–45m deep-dive I recommend including one of your infra folks (for QPS details) and our senior infra engineer Dev (copied). Soojin (SDR) is on copy to help lock a slot and prep a short mutual action plan.

Quick questions so we can tailor the session:
- Are the spike windows daily (bursty every few hours) or more periodic (e.g., end-of-day batch)?
- What model family are you planning to evaluate (open Llama-style, Llama 3, or a customer-owned model)?
- Any strict disallowed operations (no outbound logging, no third-party telemetry)?

We have availability on Tue Jan 20 at 10:00 PST for 30m with Dev; if that works I can ask Soojin to send a calendar invite with the Zoom link. Alternatively, here's a quick booking link if you'd rather self-schedule: https://calendly.com/redwood-tech/30min

Best,
Jordan Blake
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.com
[Redwood Inference — developer-first inference for production]
From: Erin Walsh <erin@parcel.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-01-19T08:47:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Quickstart CTA — request for technical demo on routing/latency

Jordan — thanks, 10:00 PST on Tue Jan 20 works for us. Bursts are mostly hourly during business hours (spikes of 200–300 qps for 2–4 minutes), plus sustained baseline at ~50–60 qps. We'll aim to have our infra lead Alex on the call.

Model: likely an open LLM (Llama family) initially; may evaluate quantized variants.

Constraints: no user PII can leave our VPC for the PoC; we also need to validate audit logs and key management (KMS).

Attaching the calendar invite (.ics) and the sample traffic you asked for previously.

Looking forward — Erin
